entities.name: PMID:10726110
observations: In female Wistar-Kyoto rats, 1% ethanol in drinking water for 14 weeks increased systolic blood pressure; a diet containing 20 times normal vitamin B6 prevented the increase.
The abstract reports prevention of ethanol-associated platelet intracellular Ca2+ elevation, tissue aldehyde-conjugate accumulation, and renal small-vessel smooth-muscle hyperplasia.
The abstract does not specify the B6 vitamer or provide numerical blood-pressure values.

entities.name: Ethanol hypertension
observations: Chronic ethanol exposure produced increased systolic blood pressure in Wistar-Kyoto rats in the direct vitamin B6 supplementation study.

entities.name: Vitamin B6
observations: A high-vitamin-B6 diet at 20 times normal dietary B6 prevented the ethanol-associated systolic blood-pressure increase in Wistar-Kyoto rats over 14 weeks.
The specific supplemented vitamer was not identified in the accessible abstract.
